status: Exploratory execution of supplied candidate cards after earlier project results were already public; not preregistered or an untouched holdout
framework: Risk priority = channel-specific external shock S times internal vulnerability V. Business relevance and chain applicability are evidence gates, not a separate E multiplier. Missing vulnerability is not zero and does not permit a complete risk score.
source_of_truth: Supplied main chain cards take precedence over contradictory First test run and Recommended changes paragraphs in ECS document. Preserve all variants separately.

test2_primary.bootstrap: paired moving blocks of four consecutive calendar quarters, 2000 resamples, percentile 95% CI, fixed seed 20261016
test2_primary.fdr: BH across primary numeric quarterly tests, supplementary flag; ordinary Spearman p is not dependence-adjusted
test2_primary.sensitivity: calendar-respecting first differences and earlier/later descriptive correlations; no re-selection

test1_weekly.week: Monday-Friday, W-FRI; exclude latest incomplete week
test1_weekly.threshold: strictly above 90th percentile of 52 preceding weekly peaks, minimum 26 preceding valid weeks, no current week
test1_weekly.pass: hit at least 2/3 applicable event windows and non-event alert proxy <=15%; at least two observable events
test1_weekly.event_overlap: week interval overlaps event window; exclude +/-20 business-day guards from non-event proxy; count each event once

test1_ecs_daily.threshold: strictly above 90th percentile of prior 252 valid daily observations, min126, exclude current
test1_ecs_daily.pass: hit fraction >=2/3 (not literal two events out of four), median in-window alarm share>=25%, non-event proxy<=15%; at least two events
test1_ecs_daily.note: Daily Test1 is controlling ECS standard paragraph; weekly peak language in some signal cells is inconsistent and reported as such
